name: Controlled Master Golden Reference
purpose: Higher-fidelity EUROIMMUN presentation certification against the real controlled PowerPoint binary master

requiredWhen: a controlled or confirmed EUROIMMUN PowerPoint binary master is available in the execution context
the output is claimed to be template-derived
the output is claimed to preserve controlled master, layout, logo or footer behavior
pixel/template parity or controlled-template verification is claimed

requiredArchetypes: figure plus bullets plus conclusion slide
failureRules: FAIL if the binary master is unavailable but template-derived or controlled-template parity is claimed
FAIL if the runtime binary SHA-256 is not recorded
FAIL if logo, footer, master or layout elements are reconstructed instead of inherited from the source template
FAIL if any applicable slide or presentation-PDF page is not rendered and inspected
FAIL if unresolved Critical or Major findings remain
FAIL if a modified artifact is delivered without repeating the affected render/parity checks

rerunRequiredWhen: corporate presentation design contract changes materially
rendering stack changes materially enough to affect pagination or slide rendering
